errors.already-exists: A file or folder with that name already exists
errors.storage-full: Not enough disk space or quota left
errors.connection-refused: The host refused the connection — check the address and port, and that the service is running
errors.host-unreachable: The host is unreachable — check the address and your network connection
errors.connection-lost-resumable: The connection was lost — retry the transfer to continue where it stopped
errors.transfer-verify-failed: The copy didn't match the original, so it was discarded — retry to copy it again
errors.transfer-source-changed: The file kept changing while it was copied — retry once it has finished being written
errors.port-in-use: Port {{port}} and the ports after it are already in use ({{attempts}} tried)
errors.remote-forward-denied: The server refused the remote forward — the port may already be in use there, or forwarding is not allowed
errors.ssh-password-rejected: Password authentication rejected — check the username and password
errors.ssh-password-expired: The server requires a new password — sign in once from a terminal and change it there
errors.ssh-prompt-unanswerable: The server asked "{{prompt}}", which can't be answered automatically
errors.ssh-no-usable-auth-method: No usable authentication method — the server only accepts: {{methods}}
errors.ssh-auth-timeout: Authentication timed out after {{seconds}}s — the server accepted the connection but never answered. Some older SSH servers stall here; try the host's "Legacy Algorithms" option, or another authentication method.
errors.login-rejected: The server rejected the username or password
errors.resource-locked: The file is locked on the server — someone else may have it open
errors.vault-sign-in-required: Team vaults require an active server connection. Sign in to continue.
errors.vault-read-only: You don't have write access to this vault. Ask a vault manager for a role that can make changes.
errors.vault-role-read-only: You don't have write access to this vault (your role: {{role}}). Only owners, managers, and editors can make changes.
errors.vault-permissions-unavailable: Unable to verify vault permissions because the keychain is unavailable. Try again.
errors.vault-permissions-corrupted: Vault permission data is corrupted. Sign in again to refresh access.
errors.knock-udp-via-proxy: UDP knocks can't go through a proxy. Use TCP steps or a direct connection for this host.
